scenarios.title: Regression confirms Maintenance Date is not used outside specified rule path

flagged.why: wrong archive path and product file

gaps: Coverage gap linked to TC_002: scenario description requires "Conditions to cover: 2) Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date does not use Maintenance Date and instead uses Assessment Date." and domain hints require "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)." Add a dedicated test case for the multi-field combination condition under current eligibility with changed Assessment Date.

Step 4 Step Description quotes "Verify that the processed file is archived under the Arkansas inbound archive path \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\AR." which contradicts domain hint "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 18 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case." together with the established resolved archive path used elsewhere in the table "archive path \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\State_of_AR."

Pre-condition quotes "Facets Certification with the product file OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb." and Step 16 Step Description quotes "enter OH-Facets-crt_69.pzb" while the same test case is for Arkansas; this conflicts with Step 17 Step Description "open the member record" after using Arkansas flow context in the same test case.
